name: They Looked Like Stars
source:
Maxwell Harrison's life has been spectacularly mundane ever since he graduated two years ago. He's a bartender in the tiny vacation town of Hilltop, where nothing exciting ever happens. He spends his time off loitering around town and sometimes even listening to his radio. It's calm. He tells himself he prefers it that way.

But then, a cave is discovered on the edge of town. And people start disappearing.

Max's life is about to become a lot less mundane.

Whether he likes it or not.

[From [url=https://amekinoko.itch.io/they-looked-like-stars]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
麦克斯韦·哈里森（Maxwell Harrison）自从两年前毕业以来，他的生活一直非常平凡。他是山顶度假小镇的一名调酒师，那里从来没有发生过什么令人兴奋的事情。休息时他会在城里闲逛，有时甚至听收音机。很平静。他告诉自己他更喜欢这样。

但随后，在城镇边缘发现了一个洞穴。人们开始消失。

麦克斯的生活即将变得不再那么平凡。

不管他喜不喜欢。

[来自[url=https://amekinoko.itch.io/they-looked-like-stars]itch.io[/url]]
